summary: Frontend-only VBOI scaffold tested end-to-end via Playwright on the live preview URL. All 12 module pages, Home, Results Dashboard, Report Generator loaded successfully. All documented data-testid controls (sliders, charts, toggles, canvas filters, sidebar links, save button, system-builder checkboxes/compile, results delete/clear, report export) are present and functional. LocalStorage persistence verified across reload. No console errors detected on any tested page.
critical_code_review_comments: Note for reviewer: sidebar-link IDs in Sidebar.jsx are derived from moduleConfig.js and use the module ids (e.g. 'lens-ray-tracing', 'beam-propagation', 'fiber-optic'), not the shortened forms ('lens', 'beam', 'fiber') mentioned in the review request. The implementation is internally consistent (VBOI.sidebarLink(m.id) matches the routes). No change needed unless the docs should be updated to reflect actual ids.
moduleConfig.js is well-structured; no DRY violations spotted. Files appear focused (<700 lines).
No hardcoded URLs in tested code; frontend correctly uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (not needed here since app is client-only).
seed_data_creation: Created one Fundamentals snapshot and one system-builder entry (TEST_System_1) via UI during testing; the system-builder card was subsequently deleted through the Results Dashboard delete button. LocalStorage may still contain the compiled system entry.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sidebar link ids follow moduleConfig.js ids (lens-ray-tracing, beam-propagation, fiber-optic, image-processing, system-builder, results-dashboard, report, plus fundamentals/microscope/raman/oct/sim). Image Processing canvas hashes confirmed to change with each filter (gray/threshold/edge) and revert to baseline on reset. Report Export triggers a JSON download (verified filename pattern like 'test_system_1_vboi_report.json'). Print button was not actually clicked to avoid blocking print dialog but the element is present and clickable.
features_verified: Sidebar visible with 4 sections and all 12 module links
Fundamentals: sliders + depth chart + save-btn increments counter
Lens: focal-length/aperture/radius sliders + ray + spot diagrams
Beam: waist/wavelength sliders + profile chart + gallery drop zone
Microscope: mode toggle clickable + PSF chart present
Image Processing: canvas renders; gray/threshold/edge/reset filters visibly modify pixel data (hashes 264→228→6630→6853→264)
System Builder: 9 checkboxes present, name input, compile increments saved count
Results Dashboard: results-list, result-card-*, result-delete-*, results-clear all present; delete works
Report Generator: export-JSON triggers download (test_system_1_vboi_report.json); print button clickable
No console errors on any tested page
